scope: Local backup import compatibility and existing-data protection
changes: Reject unknown import modes, envelope formats and export versions before writing.
Reject a backup whose storage schema is newer than this application.
Decode and validate the existing primary database directly before import; corrupt or future-version data must not be treated as an empty workspace.
Preserve both the primary database and previous import backup when validation fails.
Commit the import backup to IndexedDB before updating primary localStorage; retain previous backups.
Reject import if primary data changes while awaiting the backup.

verification.new_failure_tests: Unknown mode, unknown format, unsupported export version, future incoming schema, malformed stored JSON, missing stored collections, future stored schema
verification.browser_import_e2e: PASS in-app browser: 4004974-byte round-trip; downloaded persisted backup and post-import export databases deep-equal original. Chrome-specific acceptance remains incomplete.

limitations: This does not expand localStorage capacity or repair already-corrupt backups.
Real browser import and complete website acceptance remain separate from automated store tests.
No customer records, payment state or external services were changed by these tests.
